lastSyncedNote: Release 26.11.17 (261117): added a Developer API bullet (pull your live leaderboards and data via a developer API, PRO) to the Tournaments and Leagues cards; added Collect charity donations to the Leagues and Clubs cards (the feature already existed on Tournaments and now works in leagues and clubs); added Scheduled announcements to members (PRO) to the Clubs card. Bumped the formats count from 30+ to 50+ everywhere (meta descriptions, JSON-LD, hero copy, card tags, and the Tournaments and Leagues formats bullets). New games (20-Ball, FedEx Cup, Three Putt Poker) left under the existing formats bullets, matching how prior releases handled new games.
